subject: Coordinate Inconsistencies Between Dataframe and Telemetry Object

messages.author: 0cb1ab1dff2bfeb6
messages.subject: Coordinate Inconsistencies Between Dataframe and Telemetry Object
parts:
Hello, I've been playing around with creating home ranges using both the ctmm package estimates (KDE,AKDE, and WAKDE) as well as the MCP estimate in AdehabitatHR. I've noticed that I get different MCP estimates depending on whether I use the coordinates from my dataframe object or my telemetry object. Upon further investigation, it looks like the telemetry object uses different coordinates compared to the utm coordinates in my original dataframe. As an example, my dataframe has one observation at X=489820, Y=3723160, while that same observation in my telemetry object is recorded as X= 276.1566, Y= 130.175999. I'm not quite sure why the coordinates have been changed in the telemetry object, they don't appear to correspond to the lat/lon coordinates of the site. Am I making some kind of error with inputting my original data? Are UTM coordinates appropriate for feeding into a telemetry object? Here's my code for creating the telemetry object:

#Changing the dataframe to a telemetry object

data.TM<-as.telemetry(data.TM, timeformat="auto",timezone="UTC", timeout=Inf,datum="NAD27",
                     na.rm="row",mark.rm=FALSE,keep=FALSE,drop=TRUE) 

Apologies if I'm missing something obvious. Thanks for the help!

best,

     Jason

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Coordinate Inconsistencies Between Dataframe and Telemetry Object
parts:
Hi Jason,

as.telemetry() looks for long,lat and, failing to find that, UTM coordinates for import, but it does not retain the UTM projection, because UTM zones are not assumed to be constant within nor across datasets.

By default, as.telemetry() chooses a safe projection (2-point equidistant), which you can read off with projection().

You can set the projection to UTM using projection()<- assignment: https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/reference/projection.html

UTM is also fine if the animal is staying within the UTM zone.

Best,
Chris
